answer: Because the timing is entered against the crystal challenge, the kernel audit can replay the terrace history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 298 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 4702 identities would post 2722 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
